question_text: Outline what happens when a sensor sends an interrupt request to a controller CPU.
adaptation_rationale: Interrupt handling explicitly scoped. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: The CPU is notified that an event needs attention; at an appropriate point it suspends current execution to run the relevant handler.

marking_points.criterion: Temporarily transfers execution to handler, preserving/resuming interrupted task as appropriate.
